title: Archimedean realisation of the brane tower
html: Starting from an archimedean \mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}_1), the fibre functor \tau geometrically converts the categorical brane tower into a bundle tower. Here, \mathcal{S}_{n+1} defines the orthonormal frame bundle of J^1 \mathcal{S}_n. The connection A_n on \mathcal{S}_n satisfies the Hermitian Yang–Mills equations at each level. The first jet prolongation constructs \mathcal{S}_2 over the base manifold M_1 = \mathcal{S}_1, determining the connection A_2 via jet prolongation (\mathbb{C}).
